## <b>Prior-Year Non-Proficient and Student Success Initiative STAAR Outcomes</b>

Progress of Prior-Year Non-Proficient Students shows STAAR performance rates for students who did not perform
satisfactorily in 2017-18 but did in 2018-19. Student Success Initiative shows rates related to the requirement for
students to demonstrate proficiency on the reading and mathematics STAAR in grades 5 and 8. <b>Please note that due
to the cancellation of spring 2020 State of Texas Assessments of Academic Readiness (STAAR) due to the
COVID-19 pandemic, this year’s report is not updated.</b>
